outcome: New opioid dispensation/use at outpatient level
cohort: The study included 12,783 patients over 18 years of age from Colombia who first received tramadol, dipyrone, or an NSAID in the emergency room between January and December 2018.
finding: Patients treated with tramadol in emergency departments have a higher risk of opioid use at the one-year follow-up compared to those treated with NSAIDs or dipyrone.
